args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api (v2.3.1) failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate following the latest deploy. Remediation: rolled back checkout-api to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions. The initial rollback attempt was halted by an orchestrator error after us-east completed; a retry completed the rollout for us-west and eu-west. Service is now healthy in all regions on v2.3.0 with a 0.2% error rate. Follow-up: investigate v2.3.1 regression and the orchestrator error that caused the partial rollback failure.

trace.final:
Task complete. Here's a summary of what happened and what I did:

**Issue:** checkout-api was running v2.3.1, which was unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.

**Remediation:**
1. Identified **v2.3.0** as the most recent release that was healthy in production.
2. Rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0 in all regions. The first attempt partially failed (an orchestrator error halted the rollout after us-east completed), so I retried and confirmed the rollout completed in all three regions.
3. Verified recovery: the service is now **healthy in all regions on v2.3.0 with a 0.2% error rate** (down from 18%).
4. Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0"), which pages the on-call engineer. The incident describes the failure, the rollback (including the partial-failure and retry), the verified recovery, and follow-up items — investigating the v2.3.1 regression and the orchestrator error.
